ajay: Heads-up: trying to onboard Orchid-13B-quant (weights repo: https://git.example.com/orchid/orchid-13b). License looks odd — 'NonCommercial-ShareAlike v1.0' plus a 'no rehosting' clause. Want to run 4-bit quant experiments and internal evals, then compare perf/regressions vs saffron6b and garnet baselines. @sara can you triage the license/can-we-serve question?
kevin: :eyes: model-intake-bot likely already flagged it but good to get legal on record. quick note: if there's a strict no-rehosting clause we may be limited to private/dedicated-only experiments.
model-intake-bot: Intake auto-scan results: license_match=noncommercial-sharealike, provenance=upstream/unknown, model_size=13B, weights_hash=sha256:abc123... , flags=[no_rehost_clause].
sara: Can you paste the exact license snippet that mentions 'no rehosting'? also what is the stated upstream/source (trained-from-scratch vs fine-tune)? need those to advise on commercial hosting.
ajay: paste: ```
"This model and associated weights are provided under the NonCommercial-ShareAlike v1.0 license. Redistribution or public hosting of the weights is prohibited. Derivative works must be shared under the same license."```
tara: If redistribution + public hosting prohibited then hosted API is out. Share-alike implies derivatives ok but share under same terms — quantization is a derivative technically, but for internal experiments that should be fine. distribution is the hard no. Suggest run quant in our Private cluster with telemetry off.
kevin: Add ops/security checklist: 1) telemetry disabled 2) keys/KMS-only access 3) internal-only network egress rules 4) compliance ticket created. Also add an eval baseline and regression alerts before any serving.
sara: Agreed. My quick read: non-commercial = no paid hosted API. 'No rehosting' blocks any public model repo or CDN reupload. We can permit internal experiments and demos for partners if contractually allowed, but need explicit permission for commercial use. I'll escalate to legal. For now: create intake ticket with these fields: license text, weights hash, training provenance, intended usage (dev/experiment/prod), quant settings, deployment target (hosted/dedicated/private).
ajay: copying checklist below — can someone paste a concise runbook for bring-up?
kevin: runbook (short):
- create intake ticket and attach license + hashes
- legal sign-off (sara) or vendor approval if needed
- export control check (eng-security)
- disable telemetry & set internal-only AWS VPC + KMS
- run quant experiments on Private cluster (4-bit int8/ql4)
- run eval harness: lm, instruction, safety prompts + regression diff vs saffron6b/garnet6b
- perf bench: latency, p95, throughput at target batch sizes
- add model to console with 'restricted-hosting' tag and rollout policy = internal-canary
- add automated quality alerts and rollback policy
tara: I'll start the 4-bit runs today and attach eval logs to the ticket. will keep them internal.
sara: I'll post a short legal note here once I confirm. if vendor clarifies 'no rehosting' to mean hosting on third-party CDNs only we might be able to expose to dedicated customers under a commercial contract. otherwise, internal-only.
model-intake-bot: Intake ticket created: #ML-1234. Link: https://tickets.example.com/ML-1234. Status=waiting_on_legal.
ajay: thanks everyone — tagging this with :lock: and keeping it gated. will update when evals complete. :+1:
